content:
Amazon is serving up the best prices ever on the latest Apple Watch models for Black Friday 2026. As we push through the biggest sale of the year, with particularly fantastic deals live on AirPods Pro 3 at an insane $100 off and 2026 AirPods Max at $130 off, not to mention the wild $400 discount on M5 MacBook Air and the new all-time low on the just-released M6 MacBook Pro at $250 off, we are going to dive into this year’s Apple Watch deals.

Just about every Apple Watch Series 12 configuration is now sitting at the lowest price ever with $100 in savings while Apple Watch Ultra 4 hits a new all-time low at $150 off, and the underrated Apple Watch SE 3 sits down at $179. Check out the details below.

Apple Watch Series 12 Black Friday deals

The Series models are the most popular for a reason – they deliver a breadth of powerful features, come in at reasonable price tags, and look great doing it. The Series 12 does this better than any before it, and now it is a whole lot less expensive today for Black Friday – you can now score one at $100 off with prices starting at $299:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 $299 (Reg. $399) – All-time low
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 $349 (Reg. $449) – All-time low
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 Cell $399 (Reg. $499) – All-time low
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 Cell $449 (Reg. $549) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Pearl White $829 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 42mm Ceramic Night Blue $799 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch Series 12 46mm Ceramic Night Blue $879 (Reg. $949) – All-time low

Apple Watch Ultra 4 Black Friday deals

For me, the Ultra 4 is not only best smartwatch on the planet, but it is also the most attractive – works with just about any outfit at any time, save for maybe the three times in your life you’ll need to wear a tuxedo. It also happens to be the most powerful and feature-rich option in its class and now you can score it at the lowest price we have tracked. Only the Natural Titanium model is at $150 off right now, and we are keeping a close eye out for the Black model, but, in my opinion, the Natural model is the best one anyway (it’s just so universal and works with any color outfit):

  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 4 $649 (Reg. $799) – New all-time low

Apple Watch SE 3 Black Friday deals

Almost criminally underrated in my experience, the SE 3 with gesture support and the always-on display is more than enough Apple Watch for loads of folks – casual users, kids, grandparents, your Dad, me (most of the time), and so on. It delivers some serious bang for your buck at full price and now you can score the latest configurations starting at a new $179 all-time low for Black Friday:

  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Midnight $179 (Reg. $249) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch SE 3 40mm Starlight $179 (Reg. $249) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Midnight $209 (Reg. $279) – All-time low
  • Apple Watch SE 3 44mm Starlight $209 (Reg. $279) – All-time low
